headline: The 5 best Markup.io alternatives for agencies (2026)
standfirst: Markup.io is a fine feedback tool. The gap is usually the hours a person spends finding mistakes. Five options. One is ours. One is staying put.

superflowHeadline: Markup.io is a feedback tool. Superflow is a feedback tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every site by hand.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies that want a built-in kanban board with client feedback.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached; built-in kanban; guests comment free from a link.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue, no AI. No memory concept; each project starts blank (checked July 2026). Pricing: $50 / $80 / $150 per month, +$8 per member (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: BugHerd pins on the live page itself; Markup.io renders the live URL through a proxy and iFrame, which can break on login-gated sites. BugHerd's behind-login behavior: not yet verified. BugHerd has no flat-price plan: per-member pricing from $50 a month, against Markup.io's flat $79 for unlimited users.

entries.name: Marker.io
entries.bestFor: dev teams that live in a tracker.
entries.standout: capture into Jira, Linear, Asana, with technical metadata.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. Screenshot-first, not a live-site overlay. A formal client approval gate: not yet verified. Pricing from $39 per month annual (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Deeper tracker integrations than Markup.io's outbound-only sync via Zapier, the API, or webhooks. Screenshot-first, not a live overlay, against Markup.io's proxy and iFrame rendering of the live URL. Client approval gate: not yet verified for Marker.io; Markup.io has a Statuses plus Sign off flow.

entries.name: Usersnap
entries.limits: Product feedback, not agency client review. Human-found only. Pricing: Starter $49 to Premium from $369 per month billed yearly (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Adds in-product widgets Markup.io doesn't have. Less built for reviewing a client's live site than Markup.io's proxy-based review. Per-seat tiers from $49 a month billed yearly, against Markup.io's flat $79 for unlimited users.

entries.name: Pastel
entries.limits: Proxy-based review, not the live site: not yet verified. Light workflow. Human-found only. Pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: Same proxy premise as Markup.io, reviewing a copy rather than the live site: not yet verified for Pastel specifically. Whether Pastel matches Markup.io's Statuses plus Sign off flow: not yet verified.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on Markup.io
stayBody: Pro is $79 a month, flat, with unlimited users: admins, members, and guests. Guests review free from a share link, no signup required. Statuses plus a per-reviewer Sign off flow track approvals (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If flat-price, link-based visual commenting on websites and files, with a simple statuses and sign-off flow, is all you need, stay.

faq.question: Which is the best Markup.io alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's the checking hours, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just Markup.io with AI?
faq.answer: No. Agents find the mistakes; a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On several, Markup.io included; guests join free from a link. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
